_doc: One fact, one place. Documents and scripts restate these values only by copying from here; ops/check_facts.py flags any file that carries a different value. Change a fact here first (with an ADR when it is a model constant), then the copies.
code_hash_source: docs/freeze/M1-3406-v1.json; ops/check_freeze.py recomputes it from the 8 hashed files
neck_axis_u_source: research-log p13_3406/visual_report_2026-10-25/data/geometry.json neck_axis.u, model frame, toward the head
neck_axis_u_baked_wrong_note: prep.json u_baked is a baked-frame vector 1.216 deg off the model-frame axis; it was used for F until 2026-11-04 and is frozen inside experiments/b25_opt1/gates.py (judged with it, result unchanged on the right axis)
bed_F_cref_source: research-log p13_3406/visual_report_2026-10-25/data/geometry.json stems.sb13_a105_91e458e3.cut_centre (A's cut centre), model frame, mm
bed_F_n3_source: distal direction -z projected on the neck section, calcar side; as written in the judging files of b25 and later
bed_F_note: F = sum A / max(t, 0.25) over stem-body interface nodes with zeta <= 15 mm and |theta| <= 45 deg; the depth axis is neck_axis_u. tools/db_export.py BED_F holds the same numbers (a test compares them). Database column F from exporter 0.2.6 on.
db_latest_source: the highest db3406/v*/ with a manifest.json; ops/check_facts.py compares with the disk
